description: This file implements an example IPC server and client using socket pairs, with a custom service that echoes text in uppercase via Protocol Buffers. It includes server setup, client spawning, and RPC handling.

classes.name: MyExampleService
classes.description: A custom service implementing the ExampleService RPC, which converts input text to uppercase and responds.

methods.name: exampleEcho
methods.description: RPC method that transforms the request text to uppercase and sets it in the response.

methods.name: onComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when the RPC call completes, setting the 'done' flag.

methods.name: childProcessMain
methods.description: Main function for the child process to perform an RPC call over the socket.

methods.name: spawnClient
methods.description: Function to fork and spawn a client process, passing the socket descriptor.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a client disconnects, logging client info.
